statement: Layer-N v1 is preserved as an invalid instrument. Its qualification corpus, schedules, seals, 100 completed/partial reads, per-spawn route sidecars, per-judge qualification records, reports, and the 640-call campaign ledger are retained unchanged. v1 is NOT a judge-capability verdict and must never be reinterpreted as qualified.

codeLevelNonReinterpretation.guarantee: Layer-N v2 uses a DISTINCT schema (migration-native-review-qualification-v2) and a DISTINCT corpus schema (migration-native-review-corpus-v2). v2 candidate-review enforcement (assertNativeReviewQualified) requires the v2 schema + matching v2 corpus/instrument/threshold hashes, so a v1 record (migration-judge-qualification-v1) can NEVER satisfy v2 enforcement.
codeLevelNonReinterpretation.v1EnforcementUntouched: the v1 assertJudgeQualified / QualCorpusV1 path is left intact for regression; v2 does not delete it.
